summary: Iran struck Oman's Didamar island in the Strait of Hormuz, destroying radar and communications infrastructure and blocking the southern shipping route. President Trump declared Iran 'militarily essentially gone' after US strikes reduced its missile and drone capacity by 85%, stating the war has ended militarily. The US evacuated refueling tankers from RAF Mildenhall to Germany and raised force protection to FPCON Charlie due to Iranian threat intelligence.

sections.threat_assessment: Iran's attack on Oman's Didamar island represents a significant escalation targeting Gulf shipping infrastructure, demonstrating willingness to strike neutral states' assets in the Strait of Hormuz. Trump's claim of 85% degradation of Iranian missile and drone capacity, if accurate, suggests a major shift in military balance, yet Iranian cyber threats via 'Handala Team' and AI-enhanced offensive cyber development indicate asymmetric retaliation vectors. The US FPCON Charlie elevation and tanker evacuation reflect credible intelligence of imminent Iranian or proxy attacks on Western assets. Israeli capture of PIJ cell in West Bank shows continued counterterrorism pressure, while persistent Hermes 900 surveillance over Beirut signals preparation for potential northern escalation. Russian GRU chief's Israel visit amid US-Iran tensions suggests Moscow seeking leverage in regional security architecture.
sections.regional_response: Qatar and Saudi Arabia advocate peaceful resolution with Iran while hosting US diplomatic engagement; Qatar PM's G7 meetings in Paris indicate coordinated Gulf-European approach. Iraq's reopening of Al-Shaib crossing defies US pressure, reflecting Baghdad's balancing act between Tehran and Washington. Morocco-Israel defense deepening with permanent attaché office signals expanding Abraham Accords security cooperation. Coalition continues Houthi missile network degradation in Yemen. Russian diplomatic shuttle between Israel and Abu Dhabi positions Moscow as mediator in both Ukraine and potential US-Iran de-escalation channels. Emergency warning in Riyadh suggests Saudi Arabia anticipates direct or proxy Iranian retaliation.
sections.intelligence_notes: Simultaneous jet activity over Urmia and Dezful indicates heightened Iranian air force readiness across western and southwestern sectors. Israeli TEX2 aircraft operations over Palestine suggest ongoing ISR or strike readiness in West Bank. UK A400M military transport over Palestine may signal British support or evacuation planning. Iran's use of cyber-physical threat flyers in Tel Aviv demonstrates hybrid warfare doctrine combining psychological operations with infrastructure targeting threats. US 'Task Force Iron Gate' monitoring Iraqi border crossings aims to interdict Iranian weapons smuggling but faces Iraqi sovereignty constraints. Russian GRU chief's direct engagement with Israeli defense establishment reveals high-level military-to-military channel despite Israel's Western alignment.
